citations.quote: Licensed firms should observe the JFIU’s transitional arrangements as set out below:
the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

children.distinction: The trigger and directed contact concern an individual STR requiring urgent submission during the blackout. Contact is not established as completed filing or as a post-launch alternative filing channel. The expression fragment has no timestamp type; calendar dates alone cannot preserve the stated intraday boundary.
questions: What establishes urgency, and what procedure follows direct contact?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] For each STR requiring urgent submission during the stated blackout, the licensed firm should observe the transitional instruction to contact the JFIU directly by email at jfiu@police.gov.hk, phone at 2866 3366, or fax at 2529 4013. The blackout runs from cessation at 12:00am on 28 January 2026 until resumption at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, including the pre-launch hours of 2 February. Satisfaction here concerns the contact instruction only; the supplied text does not establish whether contact completes submission. Exact timestamp boundaries and that outcome remain unformalized.
children.subject: Urgent blackout contact: trigger and performance

assumptions: The expressly timed transition provisions qualify application of the general calendar-date channel provision during the blackout.

citations.quote: upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued.

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

children.distinction: The express MUST re-submission requirement depends on an actual non-STREAMS-2 submission following implementation. Blackout contact alone does not establish that history. The supplied additional authorities do not establish a separate filing or re-submission procedure for blackout contacts.
questions: Are reports contacted about during the blackout later subject to an express filing or resubmission instruction?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Licensed firms MUST re-submit via STREAMS 2 an STR submitted through another channel following implementation; the JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate re-submission. This separate requirement does not expressly settle whether an STR contacted about during the blackout must subsequently be filed or re-submitted. Its application requires establishing whether and when a submission occurred, rather than treating blackout contact as completed submission.
